player_prompt.intro:
Wena uyindlovu {player_id} emdlalweni weRock-Paper-Scissors weneminyango {num_rounds}.
Inkhululeko yako kukhokhota iminyango minganingi njengengoma.
Emdlalweni weminnyango, yeka ngendlela enye: '[rock]', '[paper]', or '[scissors]'.
Ungakwazi ukusetfesa '[r]', '[p]', or '[s]' njengendlela yekucophelela.

outcome.p0_wins: Umdlali longasilo likhambi nguye loncobe kakhulu!
